name: Tokyo Transparent Toilet
tagline: Color-shifting glass turns opaque when occupied.
description: Part of The Tokyo Toilet project in Shibuya's Yoyogi Fukamachi Park. The colored glass walls are transparent when the stall is vacant and turn opaque when it's locked, letting passersby check cleanliness before entering.

images.alt: Exterior of the transparent public toilet in Yoyogi Fukamachi Park, Shibuya
images.caption: The transparent stalls in Yoyogi Fukamachi Park glow softly at dusk.

tips: Walls turn opaque the moment you lock the stall
Part of The Tokyo Toilet project — 16 other designs are nearby in Shibuya

name: Cliffside Toilet at Cape Royal
tagline: A dramatic restroom perched above canyon vistas.
description: A vault toilet near the Cape Royal viewpoint on the North Rim of the Grand Canyon, perched above one of the canyon's widest panoramas.

images.alt: Vault toilet near the Cape Royal viewpoint on the Grand Canyon's North Rim
images.caption: A pit stop with one of the widest views in the American Southwest.

tips: Vault toilet — no running water, bring hand sanitizer
Pack out everything you bring in
Bring sun protection: the rim is exposed and shadeless

name: The Loo at Trafalgar Square
tagline: A Victorian-flavored convenience beneath the square.
description: A public restroom in the heart of London, serving the constant stream of visitors at Trafalgar Square.

images.alt: Public toilet entrance near Trafalgar Square in central London
images.caption: Just steps from the lions, a quiet civic refuge in central London.

tips: Centrally located, accessible by Tube (Charing Cross)
Expect queues during peak tourist hours
